_contract: Frozen oracle for the create-time CONFIG row of a channelless agent (no provider channel bound; Soleon Chat membership only), as POST /agents writes it through register_agent. A converter projection MATCHES iff: (1) every key in `required_exact` is present with exactly this value, (2) every key in `required_variable` is present and satisfies its rule, (3) NO key in `forbidden` is present, (4) no other keys are present unless listed in `optional` (server-assigned per call: present on the live row but unknowable offline; checked when present). The key sets are checked against the platform's own writer, extracted into contract.json `register_agent_row_keys` (harness/tests/test_oracle_row_keys.py).
_source: agent-infra scripts/agent_manager/registry.py register_agent: the `item` literal (lines 292-325), owner (326-333), createdBy (348-349), avatar (353-359), channels (378-382); called once by lambda/ui_admin_agents/index.py create_agent_route (13953-13992) with deploy_id, group_chat, identity, owner and tenant. The route's later deployStatus/deployStartedAt stamp (index.py:14218-14227) is the deploy lifecycle, not this write.

required_variable.PK: string matching ^APPENV#(dev|staging|prod)#AGENT#[a-z0-9-]+$ — the tenant-free form shared_keys.agent_pk(app_env, slug); the live control row prefixes TENANT#{tenantId}# (shared_keys.control_agent_pk), which an offline projection cannot know
required_variable.appEnv: string, one of dev|staging|prod; must equal the {app_env} segment of PK
required_variable.framework: string, one of the contract's frameworks (maverick)
required_variable.groupChat: object with exactly enabled (bool) and eagerness (one of only_when_asked|balanced|proactive) — group_contract.group_config of the stored config; {enabled: false, eagerness: balanced} when no groupChat is set

optional.owner_sub: Cognito sub of the creating caller — present when created via POST /agents with a JWT; server-controlled, never client-settable
optional.owner_email: the owner's email, denormalized when owner_sub is set and the email resolves
optional.createdBy: caller email when resolvable from the JWT claims
optional.tenantId: the caller's tenant from verified claims, matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,31}$ (shared_keys.validate_tenant_id); never a literal in a projection
optional.deployId: UUID the route mints per create (str(uuid.uuid4()))
optional.iconName: avatar shape, liquid:{archetype} or identicon:{seed} — drawn at random when none was chosen
optional.iconColor: avatar colour, #rrggbb — drawn at random when none was chosen
